CheckTitle: Ensure Fusion HCM Transactions Allowed by SoD Violations Are Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
SubSectionName: Application Business User Separation of Duties (SoD)
RequiredAccess: Fusion Applications Security Console / Audit Reports (IT Security Manager)
Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management (Advanced Controls)
Description: HCM transactions completed by the same user on both sides of an SoD conflict (for example payroll and personal payment methods) should be monitored.
AuditProcedure: Review the transactions in Reports and Analytics.
Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Examples: 50001, 50002, 50005.

Steps: Reverse the transaction where possible and fix the configuration that allowed it.
